# ANNOUNCEMENT: New Hybrid Work Standard

**Effective [DATE]**

We're pleased to announce our new Hybrid Work Standard, designed to support flexibility while maintaining strong team collaboration and company culture.

**Key Details:**

**Schedule:** All employees are expected to work in-office **3 days per week** (Tuesday–Thursday) and remotely **2 days per week**. Teams may adjust based on business needs in consultation with their managers.

**Getting Started:**
- Schedule your in-office days with your manager by [DATE]
- Reserve desk space using our new booking system (details in your welcome email)
- Workspace assignments will be available on a first-come basis

**What This Means for You:**
- Greater flexibility to balance work and personal commitments
- In-person collaboration on core business days
- Dedicated quiet spaces for focused remote work
- Full access to office amenities when present

**Expectations:**
- Attend all required meetings and team events in-office
- Maintain consistent communication across time zones
- Follow our IT security protocols for remote work
- Support your team's overall productivity goals

**Support:**
Questions? Visit our HR portal or contact your manager. We'll host virtual Q&A sessions on [DATES].

This hybrid approach reflects our commitment to employee wellbeing while ensuring we remain connected and productive. We're confident this standard will benefit both our people and our business.

Thank you for your continued dedication.

**[Leadership Name]**

**HARROW & VANCE SUPPLY CO.**

**ANNOUNCEMENT: NEW HYBRID WORK STANDARD**

Effective Monday, January 12, 2027, we are implementing a new hybrid work standard for office-based employees at our Macon headquarters.

**What's Changing**

Office staff will work on site three days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Remote work is permitted on Monday and Friday.

**Support for Commuters**

All headquarters employees will receive a $60 monthly parking-and-transit stipend to help offset commuting costs.

**What's Not Changing**

This policy applies only to office-based employees. Warehouse and delivery crews will continue their current schedules at all locations.

**Out-of-State Employees**

We are still finalizing the work standard for our 14 remote-only employees. Leadership will communicate those details within two weeks.

**Questions**

Your manager can answer most questions about the new schedule. HR will hold a brief Q&A session on Friday, January 9, at 2:00 p.m. in the break room (also available via Zoom—link to follow).

We recognize this change affects your routines. This structure allows us to maintain the collaboration and company culture that matter to Harrow & Vance while preserving flexibility. We appreciate your adaptability as we move forward.

Questions? Contact HR at hr@harrowvance.com or ext. 4100.

All headquarters office staff will receive a $60 monthly stipend to help offset parking and transit costs.

**Warehouse and Delivery Crews**

There is no change to current expectations. Warehouse and delivery team members in Macon, Savannah, and Dalton continue working on site as scheduled.

**Out-of-State Employees**

This announcement does not cover that case; Human Resources will follow up directly with affected employees.

**Questions**

For questions about the new standard, contact Human Resources at hr@harrowvance.com or ext. 2840.
